jobs.title: Corporate Development Lead
jobs.description:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com http://paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

You'll be the sole member of our Corporate Development function, working side by side with the executive team on Paxos's fundraising and inorganic growth. You'll partner with executive and product leadership to develop investment theses, and work with teams across the company to make sure deals deliver after they close.

About the role

The Corporate Development Lead serves as the driver of Paxos's inorganic growth strategy, identifying, structuring, and executing acquisitions, and owning process management for our fundraising efforts as we scale. You will own the full M&A lifecycle. You will also support the CEO and CFO on end-to-end fundraise processes, helping tell the Paxos story to the right capital partners at the right time.

What you’ll do

 - Own the M&A process end-to-end:
   
   - Develop Investment and M&A theses by researching and monitoring emerging trends and disruptive companies and deeply understanding Paxos product strategy and overall priorities
   
   - Source, evaluate, and execute acquisitions - lead cross-functional diligence, drive structuring, negotiation, and close
   
   - Build and maintain a live pipeline of targets aligned to Paxos’s strategic priorities across infrastructure, distribution, and regulated capabilities
   
   - Conduct analysis of operating performance, lead market diligence, and prepare investment memos. Develop rigorous financial models and valuation frameworks

 - Own fundraising process & investor relations:
   
   - Lead end-to-end equity fundraise processes - drive workstreams, prepare investor materials, build and manage data rooms, coordinate diligence, and control the process timeline; serve as the day-to-day owner ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and the CFO and CEO are focused where they matter most
   
   - Maintain ongoing relationships with current and prospective investors between raises providing regular investor updates

 - Be a strategic partner to the executive team:
   
   - Bring an informed external view - on competitors, market structure, and emerging opportunities - into our strategic planning process; translate what you’re seeing in the market into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership

 - Continue to scale Paxos Ventures. To date, Paxos has made over 25 venture investments across the digital asset space
   
   - Source, evaluate and recommend early stage venture investments that further Paxos strategic priorities
   
   - Partner cross-functionally across the company to support founders and portfolio companies
   
   - Help build our founder community by planning programs and events that convene portfolio companies, investors, and others in the ecosystem

 - Build the corp dev muscle at Paxos: Establish repeatable processes for deal sourcing, evaluation, and integration planning; develop the templates, frameworks, and institutional knowledge that make us faster and sharper with every transaction

About you

We’re looking for someone who is entrepreneurial, analytical and very comfortable operating in ambiguity. You help bring focus and structure to ambiguous situations to chart a clear path forward. You might come from investing (Banking, PE, VC) or a Corp Dev team at a fast-growing (fin)tech company.

 - Demonstrated track record of executing M&A or investment transactions - you have closed deals, not just supported them

 - Strong financial modeling and valuation skills

 - You enjoy building relationships

 - Proven ability to own a fundraising process end-to-end - managing workstreams, materials, and investor relationships with minimal oversight

 - Familiarity with the blockchain infrastructure, digital asset, or fintech space is a plus

 - Excellent communication skills - you can present a nuanced deal thesis to a CFO and explain a term sheet to an engineer

 - Comfort operating as an IC in a fast-moving environment; you don’t need a team to be effective, and you know how to pull in the right internal stakeholders at the right moment

 - You default to AI and take pride in your work. You are building agents, vibe-coding apps, and more.

 - You likely have 7+ years of work experience

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

 - Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers

 - We only use @paxos.com http://paxos.com email addresses

 - We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

 - For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

extra.compensation: $244K – $279K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • 20% annual bonus

About Paxos

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The People team is on a mission to create more than just a workplace; we're building a hub where exceptional talent thrives. We equip our leaders with innovative tools, frameworks, and tailored coaching, enabling them to excel in making great people decisions. Within People, the People Operations team owns the programs, systems and processes that make those decisions possible at scale.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on leader to join our People team as the Manager, People Operations. In this role, you’ll own the design and execution of key People programs and systems. This is a unique opportunity to blend strategic impact with tactical execution, done in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you'll do

 - Oversee the design and rollout of people programs including engagement surveys, onboarding, compliance, and systems/vendor renewals.

 - Partner with HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, and L&D to ensure processes and programs are consistent, efficient, and aligned with business priorities.

 - Lead HR systems improvements, automation, and reporting to increase accuracy and scalability.

 - Monitor people metrics and build advanced dashboards to provide actionable insights to executives and the Board.

 - Ensure policies, processes, and systems remain compliant across multiple geographies, including small or newly established international populations.

 - Support the integration of acquired employees into the People Operations lifecycle, including systems, benefits, onboarding, and compliance alignment.

About you

 - 10+ years of progressive HR/People experience, with 8-10 years focused on People Operations.

 - Proven experience supporting and scaling organizations through high-growth environments, ideally in technology or regulated industries

 - Experience integrating acquired companies' employees into HR systems and programs (M&A/onboarding integration)

 - Experience supporting small or distributed international employee populations, including navigating varying compliance and operational needs across geographies

 - Exceptional analytical skills are required -  advanced ability to model, interpret, and present complex people-data to drive clear, strategic decisions.

 - Hands-on experience with HR systems (Workday required) and proven ability to leverage technology for reporting, analytics, and process improvements.

 - Experience overseeing and implementing a wide range of HR programs across the employee lifecycle.

 - A track record of thriving in very fast-moving, ambiguous environments with sound judgment and proactive problem-solving.

 - Designing and quickly implementing solutions that cut across multiple disciplines.

 - Successful management of competing priorities, taking initiative, and driving projects to completion in a timely and accurate manner.

 - Strong communication and influencing skills across all levels, from employees to executives.

 - Bachelor’s degree and advanced HR certifications (PHR, SPHR, SHRM-SCP, MSHR) are a plus.

You might also have

 - Exceptional listening skills, a personable and approachable demeanor, and ability to relate to, influence, and coach employees of all levels in the organization.

 - Ability to work independently, as an active member of both business and the People Team.

 - Flexibility, including the ability to think strategically, execute tactically, and collaborate across many teams, levels, and situations.

 - Ability to work within constraints as well as to challenge the status quo.

___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

Our Compliance team is a cornerstone of Paxos’ trusted, regulated infrastructure, ensuring we meet the highest standards of oversight while enabling responsible innovation. The team combines deep regulatory expertise with a practical understanding of blockchain and financial markets to design and run robust, scalable compliance programs. We partner closely with business and product teams to build solutions that protect our customers and our company, while supporting sustainable growth across both traditional and digital asset environments

About the role

In this role, you'll lead the delivery, implementation, and continuous improvement of Compliance's internal tools and operational processes. You'll partner closely with Compliance SMEs, Product, Engineering, Data, and third-party vendors to translate compliance requirements into well-defined technology solutions that are delivered on schedule, thoroughly tested, and successfully adopted by the Compliance team. In addition, you'll drive initiatives that strengthen Compliance operations, including AI enablement, vendor management, KPI and operational reporting, resource planning, process improvements, training, and change management to help the team scale effectively.

What you'll do

 - Own the roadmap and delivery of Compliance- tooling and technology initiatives, partnering with Product and Engineering to prioritize work, track timelines, and ensure delivered solutions meet Compliance requirements.

 - Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of Compliance technology initiatives, including intake, prioritization, backlog management, roadmap planning, UAT, launch readiness, rollout, and post-launch support.

 - Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), validate delivered functionality against business requirements, and ensure implementation evidence is documented in an audit-ready manner.

 - Serve as the primary liaison between Compliance, Product, Engineering, Data, and technology vendors for Compliance tooling.

 - Manage relationships with Compliance vendors, including feature requests, issue escalation, roadmap discussions, and implementation planning.

 - Lead implementation and adoption of new Compliance tools, including communications, training, documentation, and change management.

 - Identify opportunities to improve Compliance processes through automation, AI, and workflow enhancements.

 - Develop and maintain operational dashboards, KPI reporting, and materials for weekly operational reviews and leadership reporting.

 - Coordinate resource planning, project tracking, and dependencies across Compliance initiatives.

 - Support regulatory exams, audits, and issue remediation efforts by maintaining accurate implementation documentation and evidence.

About you

 - 6–10 years of experience in Compliance, Financial Crimes, Risk, Product Operations, Product Compliance, or Program Management within financial services, fintech, or digital assets.

 - Strong working knowledge of BSA/AML and OFAC sanctions requirements, with the ability to research and apply regulatory requirements to operational and technology initiatives.

 - Experience supporting the full technology delivery lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design reviews, UAT, launch readiness, and post-launch enhancements.

 - Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects involving Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Operations, with ownership of timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communications.

 - Strong project management skills, including roadmap planning, intake and prioritization, Jira management, dependency tracking, UAT coordination, rollout planning, and documentation.

 - Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into clear product requirements and testable acceptance criteria.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience developing procedures, UAT plans, implementation documentation, status reporting, and executive updates.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and escalating risks and trade-offs appropriately.

 - Demonstrated interest in using AI tools, workflow automation, and emerging technologies to improve Compliance operations.

jobs.title: Compliance Associate
jobs.description:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com http://paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the role

As a Compliance Associate, you will help safeguard the integrity of Paxos’ digital asset ecosystem through hands-on monitoring and investigations. You will support “in the wild” monitoring of Paxos‑issued stablecoins, assist with complex blockchain investigations, and contribute to information sharing with law enforcement agencies and regulatory bodies.

You will work closely with senior team members to develop deep expertise in digital asset compliance, gain exposure to cutting-edge blockchain analytics tools, and build skills in financial crime investigations and SAR/STR reporting.

What you'll do

 - Monitor activity across Paxos‑issued stablecoins using blockchain analytics tools, triaging alerts and escalating higher‑risk activity to senior investigators as appropriate.

 - Conduct first‑line investigations into potential suspicious activity, synthesizing KYC, transactional, and open‑source information into clear case files and recommendations.

 - Support quarterly forensic reviews of stablecoin transactions to identify trends, typologies, and emerging risks, documenting findings for leadership and auditors.

 - Assist with the intake and management of internal referrals, collaborating with real‑time monitoring, product, legal, and other cross‑functional stakeholders to resolve complex cases.

 - Help maintain information‑sharing workflows with law enforcement agencies, regulators, and industry partners, ensuring timely and well‑documented responses.

 - Draft clear, well‑structured investigation summaries, SAR/STR supporting documentation, and case narratives that meet regulatory and internal quality standards.

 - Use AI tools to speed up investigative workflows (e.g., triage, data summarization, drafting), while maintaining ownership and accountability for final decisions and outputs.

 - Contribute to continuous improvement of procedures, playbooks, and training materials for transaction monitoring, investigations, and reporting.

 - Participate in the team’s rotating weekend/on‑call coverage and occasional travel to support training, audits, or regulatory meetings, as needed for the role.

About you

 - Experience: 2+ years of experience in compliance, financial crime investigations, AML, sanctions, law enforcement, or a related risk function (experience with digital assets is a plus).

 - Investigations skills: Comfort analyzing large volumes of transactional data, identifying red flags, and structuring end‑to‑end investigations, including SAR/STR considerations.

 - Blockchain / digital asset interest: Exposure to blockchain analytics tools (e.g., transaction tracing, wallet clustering) or a demonstrated interest and aptitude to learn them quickly.

 - Regulatory & law enforcement exposure: Experience working with information‑sharing protocols, subpoenas, or other law‑enforcement/regulatory requests is strongly preferred.

 - Writing & documentation: Proven ability to produce clear, concise, and well‑organized investigative reports and documentation that meet regulatory and internal standards.

 - AI enablement: Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve how you work (e.g., research, drafting, quality checks) or a strong willingness to adopt them in daily workflows.

 - Mindset & working style: Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate in a fast‑paced, highly regulated environment.

 - Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, criminal justice, law, data/analytics, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience in investigations or financial crime compliance.
